useWhen: An operator hands over a journal export (MoneyForward, freee, Yayoi, QuickBooks Online or Xero) and asks for a trial balance, P&L or balance sheet, whether the books balance, or a conversion to another of these formats
avoidWhen: Posting to a live accounting company, filing taxes or claiming 電子帳簿保存法 compliance; handling a real ledger on a remote inference rail without the operator's consent

inputs.context: currency, date order and the period the operator cares about

outputs.statements: trial balance, P&L and balance sheet with the checks behind them
outputs.conversion: the journal in another format, with notes on fields that format cannot hold

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be enabled in the profile by its owner

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers matches the entry id.
